answer: Epochally Anchored Behavioural Fingerprint. Each identity gets a persistent pigment derived from its first-epoch interaction vector; every later epoch must reproduce that vector within a tight tolerance. A mismatch in any single operation flags the identity and resets its standing, so a sockpuppet swarm cannot quietly evolve. Like a garden that must regrow from the same seed each season, the profile is re-derived rather than stored, and a comet-like burst of new identities all starting fresh is throttled to one seeded profile per origin cluster per epoch.
